title: A kite
done: Whoosh! A kite flying high, with a tail that flutters.

steps.say: Lay it flat on the table. Top row, left to right: 2 gaps, a red corner triangle in the bottom right, a red corner triangle in the bottom left.
Next row down, left to right: a gap, a red corner triangle in the bottom right, a red square, a yellow square, a yellow corner triangle in the bottom left.
Next row down, left to right: a red corner triangle in the bottom right, 2 red squares, 2 yellow squares, a yellow corner triangle in the bottom left.
Next row down, left to right: a blue corner triangle in the top right, 2 blue squares, 2 green squares, a green corner triangle in the top left.
Next row down, left to right: a gap, a blue corner triangle in the top right, a blue square, a green square, a green corner triangle in the top left.
Next row down, left to right: 2 gaps, a blue corner triangle in the top right, a green corner triangle in the top left.
Next row down, left to right: 3 gaps, an orange square.
Next row down, left to right: 2 gaps, an orange square.
Next row down, left to right: 3 gaps, an orange square.
